setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed. Use --configLoader=runner to work around macOS sandbox preventing writes to apps/web/node_modules/.vite-temp/
environment_constraints: macOS sandbox prevents writes to apps/web/node_modules/.vite-temp/ (com.apple.provenance restriction). Always use --configLoader=runner flag with vitest. The .vite-temp directory cannot be deleted or chmod'd. This does NOT affect builds or the actual app - only the vitest config loading.
contribution_requirements: From CONTRIBUTING.md: keep changes small and test-backed. Run npm test, npm run lint, npm run build before PR. No speculative features documented as working.
key_patterns: 1) Components use Tailwind utility classes (cn() from @/lib/utils for conditionals) alongside BEM-style CSS classes in styles/*.css. The design-console CSS layer overrides the base styles. 2) State management via React hooks - no Redux/Zustand. 3) Keyboard shortcuts registered via window.addEventListener in useEffect. 4) CSS custom properties (CSS vars) for theming. 5) SVG icons inline. 6) lucide-react used in Terminal.tsx but not in conversation components (those use inline SVG). 7) forwardRef pattern in ConversationTurnBubble. 8) Hooks return objects with named fields. 9) useCallback/useMemo for stability. 10) Tests use fireEvent and waitFor from @testing-library/react. 11) Mocks done with vi.mock() / vi.stubGlobal(). 12) ConversationsPrimaryView gets sendMessage from useConversationsRuntime. 13) TerminalChatPane is used elsewhere (canvas/deck views) and has its own mode toggle for chat/terminal.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/components/ - all UI components. apps/web/src/app/ - hooks, utilities, types. apps/web/src/styles/ - CSS files. apps/web/tests/ - vitest tests. packages/core/ - shared types (TranscriptMessage, QuestionForm, etc).
